build_vit_1d: build a ViT model for 1D time series classification with patch embedding and cls token
create_attention: create a multi-head attention module with qkv projection and softmax scaling
create_feedforward: create a feedforward MLP block with layer norm, GELU activation, and dropout
create_transformer: create a transformer encoder stack with alternating attention and feedforward layers
test_vit_forward: test the ViT forward pass on 1D time series input to produce classification logits
